inputSpecification:
The model was trained on 10 cm resolution multi-channel imagery, including DSM and DTM data, RGB-NIR orthophotos, and RGB-NIR oblique images (LOD). 
All 10 available channels were used.
outputSpecification:
resolution and size is the same as input
gives logits for each class 
classes are: asphalt, paving_stones, gravel, unpaved, green_roof, greenhouse,  concrete_surface, cobblestones
trainingDataOrigin: KDS spring ortofoto ,  oblique images (LOD) lidar based DSM DTM
